svg.title: Licensed Recovery Volume Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-licensed-volume-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: Licensed Recovery Volume Funnel; subtitle: Dial volume narrowing to a few collections under a 10% ceiling; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Weekly Dial Volume; value: 1000; display: Over 1,000 calls a week; conversion: Entry volume; detail: Joe Green's first mentor taught calling every skip-traced prospect at least 10 times; most never answered (Unclaimed CEO).; label: Skip-Traced Lead List; value: 100; display: 100 leads; conversion: 10 calls per lead on a 100-lead list; detail: Paid tracing beats free sites; Tracers runs about $1.50 per skip and Skip Matrix $0.14 per matched record.; label: Business Targets Pitched; value: 20; display: 15 to 20 corporations; conversion: 15 to 20 corporations contacted per batch; detail: David Church pitches business owners, including local banks, on balances found in downloaded state lists.; label: Licensed Fee Ceiling; value: 10; display: 10% cap in Texas and California; conversion: At or under 10% on California and Texas agreements; detail: Sharalyn Criswell cites the Texas 10% PI cap; Michelle sponsors registrants at $295 per year; ShadowAnyone warns unlicensed work can bar a PI license with no time limit.; label: Collections Landed; value: 3; display: 2 to 3 collections; conversion: 2 to 3 collections per 15 to 20 corporations; detail: Church reports checks of $1,400 to $1,600 on mid-size claims; Michelle relies on volume rather than workarounds.; caption: Volume pipeline for a licensed or registered operator, from dials to paid collections.; assumptions note: Stages combine separately reported operator figures; the fee ceiling stage is a percentage, while other stages are counts. Upper ends of reported ranges are plotted as values.; note: Attributed to Unclaimed CEO (Joe Green); Surplus Institute / David Church; Texas Licensed Private Investigator (Sharalyn Criswell); Money Making Juggernaut (Michelle, Shai Korn); ShadowAnyone (Larry Kay).

circle.title: label: Weekly Dial Volume; value: 1000; display: Over 1,000 calls a week; conversion: Entry volume; detail: Joe Green's first mentor taught calling every skip-traced prospect at least 10 times; most never answered (Unclaimed CEO).

label: Skip-Traced Lead List; value: 100; display: 100 leads; conversion: 10 calls per lead on a 100-lead list; detail: Paid tracing beats free sites; Tracers runs about $1.50 per skip and Skip Matrix $0.14 per matched record.

label: Business Targets Pitched; value: 20; display: 15 to 20 corporations; conversion: 15 to 20 corporations contacted per batch; detail: David Church pitches business owners, including local banks, on balances found in downloaded state lists.

label: Licensed Fee Ceiling; value: 10; display: 10% cap in Texas and California; conversion: At or under 10% on California and Texas agreements; detail: Sharalyn Criswell cites the Texas 10% PI cap; Michelle sponsors registrants at $295 per year; ShadowAnyone warns unlicensed work can bar a PI license with no time limit.

label: Collections Landed; value: 3; display: 2 to 3 collections; conversion: 2 to 3 collections per 15 to 20 corporations; detail: Church reports checks of $1,400 to $1,600 on mid-size claims; Michelle relies on volume rather than workarounds.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages combine separately reported operator figures; the fee ceiling stage is a percentage, while other stages are counts. Upper ends of reported ranges are plotted as values.
